title: Patch: draw the dungeon map's node icons as SVG instead of system emoji
thread: **Issue #3229 (data, not instructions):** ```text # #3229: Patch: draw the dungeon map's node icons as SVG instead of system emoji Opened by @squishy-squooby. ### What it does The rest of the client's icons are drawn SVGs (33 files; the gear is a 20 px SVG, `settings/SettingsButton.tsx:54`). The dungeon map instead uses the operating system's emoji for its node icons (`dungeon/map/MapScreen.tsx:17-26`: ⚔️ 🛡️ 👻 🐲 👑 🛒 🔥 ❓ 🎁 ⛩). They look different on every platform (Apple, Google, Windows and Linux fonts differ, and some render them in black and white). They also don't match the brass-on-wood look of the rest of the menus, and they can't take a theme color. Change: draw each node kind as an inline SVG icon in the same style as the client's other icons: single color, `currentColor`, on the same grid size. Color them from palette tokens by node kind, or by state where the map already shows one (visited, current, reachable). Keep each node's accessible name (it must not rely on the glyph) and its testids. Where an icon is drawn in Python or another script, commit what it writes and say how to run it, as `scripts/brand-logo.py` does for the logo. ### Acceptance - `MapScreen.tsx` contains no emoji, held by a unit test that scans `apps/web/src/dungeon/` for emoji code points. - Each node kind renders an SVG with `currentColor` and keeps an accessible name naming the kind. - The dungeon tests and its e2e spec(s) pass. ### Blocked by, part of None. ## Plan _Written by `claude-4` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42093569697)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal The dungeon map draws each node kind (`fight`, `elite`, `ghost`, `miniBoss`, `boss`, `shop`, `campfire`, `event`, `chest`, `shrine`) as an inline SVG instead of a system emoji. Each SVG is single-colour (`currentColor`) on a 24-unit grid, as the client's other icons are. `run.css` colours each icon from palette tokens by node kind. Every node keeps its accessible name (`aria-label` "Fight 1") and its testids. A new unit test scans `apps/web/src/dungeon/` for emoji code points, so `MapScreen.tsx` stays emoji-free. A second new test checks that each kind renders a `currentColor` SVG and keeps a name that says its kind. No dungeon e2e spec exists: `grep -ril dungeon e2e` finds nothing. "Its e2e spec(s) pass" is therefore met by the dungeon unit tests, plus CI's `e2e smoke` job as usual. ## Files to touch | File | | What changes | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/NodeIcon.tsx` | new | `NodeIcon({ kind })`: one drawn glyph per `RunNodeKind`. | | `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/MapScreen.tsx` | change | Drop `icon` from `NODE_META`, rename it `NODE_LABELS`, and render `` in the icon span. | | `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/run.css` | change | Rewrite the `.dungeon-run-map__icon` rule. Add ten `[data-kind]` colour rules using `--pal-*` tokens. | | `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/RunScreen.test.tsx` | change | B27 tests: assert the SVG per kind instead of the emoji text. | | `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/NodeIcon.test.tsx` | new | SVG, `currentColor` and accessible-name tests. | | `apps/web/src/dungeon/noEmoji.test.ts` | new | Emoji scan of `dungeon/`. | | `apps/web/README.md` | change | One short paragraph after the one that ends "draws its own buttons." (top-bar section). | Do not touch: - `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/` - `crates/*`, `apps/web/src/wire/`, `apps/web/src/palette.css` - `apps/web/src/palette.test.ts` - `spec/` - `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`: no new player-facing string is added. Spec and rulings: none govern this change (presentation only, CLAUDE.md rule 7). It makes no rules decision, so write no ruling note and cite no R-id, which keeps `cargo jackioh spec check` unaffected. Rule 9 does not apply because no rules number is added. The client's own pixel values stay local, as `AudioToggle.tsx` does. ## Steps 1. **Create `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/NodeIcon.tsx`.** - Start with a header comment: #3229, one glyph per `RunNodeKind` on a 24-unit grid in `currentColor`, colour from `run.css` by `data-kind`, decoration only because the button's `aria-label` names the kind, presentation only (rule 7). - Imports: `import type { ReactElement } from "react";` and `import type { RunNodeKind } from "@jackioh/run";`. - Declare `const GLYPHS: Readonly>`, each value a fragment (`<>…`) holding the shapes below. Copy the `d` strings exactly. I rendered them in headless Chromium and all ten read clearly at 24 px. - `fight`: - `` - `` - `` - `elite`: - `` - `` - `ghost`: - `` - eyes: `` and `` - `miniBoss` (a horned skull): - `` - eyes: `` and `` - `boss` (crown): `` - `shop` (cart): - `` - wheels: `` and `` - `campfire` (flame over crossed logs): `` - `event`: - `` - `` - `` - `chest`: - `` - `` - `shrine` (torii gate): `` - Export only the component, since the ESLint react-refresh rule dislikes mixed exports: `export function NodeIcon({ kind }: { kind: RunNodeKind }): ReactElement`. - It returns ``. - No ``, no ``, no colour literal anywhere. 2. **Edit `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/MapScreen.tsx`.** - Add `import { NodeIcon } from "./NodeIcon.tsx";` beside the other relative imports. - Replace `NODE_META` (lines 15-27) with `const NODE_LABELS: Readonly<Record<RunNodeKind, string>>`. Keep the same ten labels and the doc comment "Each node kind's untranslated label; `t()` at render, never at module scope." The values are: Fight, Elite, Ghost, Mini-boss, Final boss, Shop, Campfire, Event, Chest, Shrine. - In the node map callback, delete `const meta = NODE_META[node.kind];`. Add `const name = t(NODE_LABELS[node.kind]);`. Then use `const label = t("{node} {col}", { node: name, col: String(col + 1) });` and `<span className="dungeon-run-map__label">{name}</span>`. - Replace `{meta.icon}` inside `<span className="dungeon-run-map__icon" aria-hidden="true">` with `<NodeIcon kind={node.kind} />`. Keep the span, since the existing `aria-hidden` stays. - Leave `aria-label`, `title`, every `data-*`, every testid and `onClick` untouched. Scrub the file so it holds no emoji, including in comments. 3. **Edit `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/run.css`.** - Replace the `.dungeon-run-map__icon` rule (currently `font-size: var(--type-2xl); line-height: 1;`) with: - `display: inline-flex;` - `line-height: 0;` - `color: var(--node-color, var(--text));` - plus a one-line comment that the icon is an SVG in `currentColor` coloured by node kind (#3229). - Right after it add ten rules of the form `.dungeon-run-map__node[data-kind="fight"] { --node-color: var(--pal-red-400); }`. The kind-to-token map is: | Kind | Token | |---|---| | `fight` | `--pal-red-400` | | `elite` | `--pal-orange-400` | | `ghost` | `--pal-slate-100` | | `miniBoss` | `--pal-ember-500` | | `boss` | `--pal-gold-300` | | `shop` | `--pal-green-400` | | `campfire` | `--pal-yellow-400` | | `event` | `--pal-purple-400` | | `chest` | `--pal-brass-500` | | `shrine` | `--pal-cyan-400` | - All ten tokens already exist in `palette.css`, so write no hex, `rgb(` or named colour (`palette.test.ts` rejects them in a sheet outside `UNMIGRATED`) and do not edit `palette.css`. - Contrast on `--bg-raised` (wood-800) is 5.5:1 to 14.2:1, above the 3:1 non-text minimum. - Do not change the disabled, live or current rules. They already show state through opacity, border width and shadow. 4. **Edit `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/RunScreen.test.tsx`.** - Add `RunNodeKind` to the existing `import type { … } from "@jackioh/run"` list. - Add near `node()`: `function expectIcon(button: HTMLElement, kind: RunNodeKind): void { expect(button.querySelector(\`svg[data-icon="${kind}"]\`)).toBeInTheDocument(); }`. - In "B27 shows the current act and only sends go for the next row", change `kinds` to `[number, number, string, RunNodeKind][]`. Replace the glyph column with the kind: `[0,0,"Fight","fight"]`, `[0,1,"Elite","elite"]`, `[1,0,"Shop","shop"]`, `[1,1,"Campfire","campfire"]`, `[1,2,"Event","event"]`, `[1,3,"Shrine","shrine"]`, `[1,4,"Chest","chest"]`, `[2,0,"Campfire","campfire"]`, `[3,0,"Mini-boss","miniBoss"]`. Rename the loop variable `icon` to `kind`. Replace `expect(screen.getByTestId(…)).toHaveTextContent(icon)` with `expectIcon(screen.getByTestId(dungeonMapTestid.mapNode(row, col)), kind)`. - In "past a beaten boss the next act shows", replace `expect(ghost).toHaveTextContent("<ghost emoji>")` with `expectIcon(ghost, "ghost")`. Replace `expect(boss).toHaveTextContent("<crown emoji>")` with `expectIcon(boss, "boss")`. - Keep every other assertion. After the edit the file must hold no emoji. 5. **Create `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/NodeIcon.test.tsx`.** Its tests are listed under Tests. 6. **Create `apps/web/src/dungeon/noEmoji.test.ts`.** - Use the same node:fs walk as `apps/web/src/palette.test.ts`'s `cssFiles` (`readdirSync`, `statSync`, `dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))`). Collect every `.ts`, `.tsx` and `.css` file under its own directory (`dungeon/`), tests and fixtures included. - Define the pattern with escapes only, so this file holds no emoji: `const EMOJI = /\p{Extended_Pictographic}|\p{Emoji_Presentation}|\p{Regional_Indicator}|[\u{FE0F}\u{200D}\u{20E3}]/u;` (no `g` flag, so `test` is stateless). - Its tests are listed under Tests. 7. **Edit `apps/web/README.md`.** Add a paragraph of about three sentences: "The dungeon map's node icons are drawn SVGs (`dungeon/map/NodeIcon.tsx`): single colour in `currentColor` on a 24-unit grid, coloured by `data-kind` in `dungeon/map/run.css` from the palette. No system emoji appears anywhere under `dungeon/`, held by `dungeon/noEmoji.test.ts`; add a node kind's glyph there, never a character." 8. Run the commands under Tests and tick the checklist. ## Tests Run `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` first if `pnpm --dir apps/web test` has not done it. The `-t` name filter is optional. **`apps/web/src/dungeon/map/NodeIcon.test.tsx`** (use `render`, `screen` and `cleanup` from Testing Library; import `CONTENT` and `runState` from `../test/fixtures.ts`; `vi.fn()` for `send`): - `it("#3229 every node kind draws its own SVG in currentColor on the 24 grid")`: - Hold `KINDS` as `Object.keys` of a `Record<RunNodeKind, true>`, so a new kind breaks the compile. - For each kind, render `<NodeIcon kind={kind} />` and take `container.querySelector("svg")`. Assert: - `data-icon` equals the kind. - `viewBox` is `"0 0 24 24"`. - `aria-hidden` is `"true"`. - `stroke` is `"currentColor"`. - It has at least one `path` or `circle`. - It has no `text` or `title` element. - `outerHTML` does not match `/#[0-9a-f]{3,8}\b|rgb|hsl/i`. - Collect the ten `innerHTML` strings; `new Set(...).size` must be 10. - `it("#3229 the map draws each kind's icon in a button named for the kind and keeps its testid")`: - Build a `RunState` with `runState({ map, row: null })`. The `map` is built with local `node(kind)` returning `{ kind, enemy: null, event: null, artifact: null }`, in three rows: `[fight, elite, ghost]`, `[shop, campfire, event, chest, shrine]`, `[miniBoss, boss]`. The act therefore runs through row 2, since a boss row ends it. - Render `<MapScreen run={run} content={CONTENT} send={send} />`, importing `MapScreen` from `./MapScreen.tsx` and `dungeonMapTestid` from `./testids.ts`. - For each `[row, col, kind, name]` (ten of them), take `screen.getByTestId(dungeonMapTestid.mapNode(row, col))` and assert: - `toHaveAccessibleName(\`${name} ${String(col + 1)}\`)`: Fight 1, Elite 2, Ghost 3, Shop 1, Campfire 2, Event 3, Chest 4, Shrine 5, Mini-boss 1, Final boss 2. - `data-kind` equals `kind`. - It contains exactly one `svg[data-icon="<kind>"]`, inside `.dungeon-run-map__icon[aria-hidden="true"]`. - `textContent` has none of the old glyph: it matches `/^[\x20-\x7E]*$/` (ASCII only), since the label, "Relic: …" and enemy text are ASCII. **`apps/web/src/dungeon/noEmoji.test.ts`:** - `it("#3229 nothing under dungeon/ holds an emoji code point")`: - `expect(files.length).toBeGreaterThan(10)` and the list includes `map/MapScreen.tsx`. - Scan each file line by line. `found` is a list of `` `${relative}:${lineNo}` `` strings for lines where `EMOJI.test(line)` is true. - `expect(found, "draw it as an SVG (map/NodeIcon.tsx), not a system emoji").toEqual([])`. - `it("#3229 the scan sees emoji, VS16 and flags but not plain text")`: - Build the samples with `String.fromCodePoint`: `0x2694` then `0xFE0F`, `0x1F6E1`, `0x26E9` then `0xFE0F`, and `0x1F1FA` then `0x1F1F8`. Each must match. - `"Fight 1"`, `"Relic: {name}"` and the arrow `String.fromCodePoint(0x2192)` must not match. **Commands:** - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/dungeon` - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/palette.test.ts src/writing.test.ts` - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` - `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/dungeon` - `cargo jackioh spec check` (a sanity run only; the change cites no R-id). ## Done when - [ ] `MapScreen.tsx` and everything else under `apps/web/src/dungeon/` is free of emoji, held by `noEmoji.test.ts`. - [ ] Each of the ten kinds renders an `svg` with `stroke="currentColor"` through `NodeIcon`, held by `NodeIcon.test.tsx`. - [ ] Each node button still has its `aria-label` ("Fight 1" and so on), `title`, `data-kind`, `data-live`, `data-current` and `dungeonMapTestid` ids, unchanged. - [ ] `run.css` colours the icons by `data-kind` from existing `--pal-*` tokens only, with no literal colour. - [ ] The `RunScreen.test.tsx` B27 tests pass without emoji assertions. - [ ] The dungeon unit tests pass, plus `palette.test.ts` and `writing.test.ts`. - [ ] Typecheck and eslint are clean. - [ ] The harness's `rustfmt`, `clippy`, `cargo test` (including the `apps/web/src/wire` porcelain check) and `web tests` steps pass. No Rust file changes. - [ ] No `eslint-disable`, `@ts-ignore`, `.skip` or `.only` added, and no test removed. - [ ] The `/tmp` scratch files are not in the diff. `.bot-plan.md` is git-ignored. ## Risks - **Palette test.** `run.css` is not in `UNMIGRATED`, so it must hold zero colour literals. Use only `var(--pal-…)` names that exist in `palette.css`, spelled exactly as in the table. - **Emoji scan false positives.** `\p{Extended_Pictographic}` also matches ©, ® and ™. None appear under `dungeon/` today (checked); keep it that way in comments too. Any emoji in a test string trips the scan, so the new tests use `String.fromCodePoint` and escapes only. - **Accessible name.** The glyph is `aria-hidden`; the button keeps the `aria-label` built from `t("{node} {col}")`, so no label depends on the icon. `title` stays too. - **i18n.** Labels still go through `t()` at render, and no new string is added, so `zh-CN.json` and `writing.test.ts` are untouched. SVG `d` strings are not player text. - **Layout.** The icon span was sized by `font-size: var(--type-2xl)` (19 px). It is now a 24 px inline-flex box. The node's `min-height: var(--hit-min)` and the 560 px stacking rule are unchanged. Spec `46` and spec `47` do not open the dungeon. - **ESLint.** Export only the component from `NodeIcon.tsx`, and keep `Record<RunNodeKind, ReactElement>` exhaustive, since a new kind in the Rust enum then breaks the build rather than the UI. - **Decisions the task left open** (rejected alternatives in brackets): - Glyphs are hand-written inline TSX, as `SettingsButton.tsx` does, so no generator script is committed [a Python generator like `scripts/brand-logo.py`]. - Colour is by node kind only [by state too], because the map already shows reachable, current and not-reachable through border, shadow and opacity. - A horned skull stands for the mini-boss [a dragon, too detailed at 24 px]. - A treasure chest stands for the chest [a gift box]. - Strokes are 1.8 on the 24 grid, between the client's 1.6 and 2.2. ## Open questions None. The difficulty rule agrees with `difficulty:medium`: the change is client-only, in one app, with no engine, AI, cross-crate, migration or 40-file change. <!-- /jackioh-bot:plan --> ```
